title: Friday Night Magic 2011: card flavor text

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane that an expedition journal writer hopes to envision free of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose presence darkens visions of Zendikar's future.

entities.name: Rhox
entities.description: A race whose monks are dedicated to spiritual growth and learning, bear the sigils of many students, and do not gladly suffer fools or those who disagree with their dogma.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane where having flesh is increasingly a liability.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A world as cruel as its inhabitants, whose brutal struggles scar the land as it carves them in its image.

relations.note: The Eldrazi are part of Zendikar's present, which the journal writer hopes to see beyond.
relations.quote: I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi.
